The '''Lialic system''' was a part of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Lialic II]]''.<ref name="KatholOutback">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lialic [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" />
